author: GameTrailers
description:
Watch the latest Grounded 2 trailer to see what to expect with the Beat the Heat update, which brings a massive new horned lizard boss, King Dozer, to the action-adventure game. The Beat the Heat update also features Buggy Progression to evolve your favorite buggies, the mysterious new Sinkhole Anthill to explore, modified O.R.C. creatures, combat updates, and deeper survival systems to uncover. Grounded 2's Beat the Heat update is now live in Game Preview on Xbox Series X|S, Xbox on PC, and Xbox Cloud, and in Early Access on Steam.

#Grounded2 #Gaming #IGN
title: Grounded 2 - Beat the Heat Update Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Watch nearly 10 minutes of gameplay from Ranger's Path: National Park Simulator in this latest video for the park management adventure sim game. The new video takes you on a quest to repair an information panel, where we get to see traversal gameplay, photography mechanics, clearing pathways, and more. Ranger's Path: National Park Simulator is out now in Early Access for PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).

Begin your park ranger journey in Ranger’s Path: National Park Simulator. Maintain trails, assist visitors, check permits and respond to emergencies. Explore diverse biomes and observe varied animal behaviors across a wide range of species.

#RangersPathNationalParkSimulator #Gaming #IGN
title: Ranger's Path: National Park Simulator - Official Gameplay Video

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss the Accolades Trailer for Hades 2, the hit roguelike action-adventure sequel developed by Supergiant Games. Players will take on the Titan of Time across and beyond the Underworld as the immortal Princess. Acquire boons from the Olympian Gods, make good use of weapons imbued with ancient magick, and overcome the odds across a deep narrative. Take a look at the latest trailer to garner the critical reception behind Hades 2, available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Cloud, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).

#Hades2 #Gaming #IGN
title: Hades 2 - Official Accolades Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Anniversary Trailer for White Knuckle, a first-person speed running roguelite climbing game developed by Dark Machine Games. Players can take a look at the new additions coming with the upcoming update to celebrate the game's anniversary, with an economy rework, facility upgrades, a new challenge map, and more. White Knuckle is available now in Early Access for PC (Steam).
title: White Knuckle - Official Anniversary Update Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the trailer for Eastwynne, an upcoming narrative-focused CRPG set in the grandiose city of Eastwynne, where magic is commonplace. It's 2021, and the start of a new college year. Follow the stories of a group of magical university students; how will your choices alter their lives? Eastwynne will be available on PC. A Kickstarter campaign is available now, and a demo is out now on Steam.
title: Eastwynne - Official Kickstarter Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: We Gotta Go is available now on Steam. Watch the We Gotta Go launch trailer for this co-op horror comedy that’ll scare the crap out of you—literally. Team up to reach the only bathroom in a haunted mansion before your bowels betray you. Scavenge for items, fend off ghosts, and fight through cursed halls together in a desperate hunt for sweet relief.
title: We Gotta Go - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss the Kickstarter Trailer for Dice Throne Digital, the hit adaptation of the card-game battler board game developed by Nerd Ninjas. Engage in intense 1v1 tactical card-based gameplay with unique heroes, abilities, and more to succeed in the ultimate fight for the throne. Dice Throne Digital is coming soon to iOS, Android, Meta Quest, and PC (Steam), with a Kickstarter available now to support the game's development. 

Support Dice Throne Digital on Kickstarter here: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/dicethrone/dice-throne-digital
title: Dice Throne Digital - Official Kickstarter Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's your look at the Auto Battleships announcement trailer for this upcoming PvP auto battler game, where you build and upgrade a fleet of ships in a roguelike fashion! Scout your opponent's position before battle and prepare your board with the information gathered in mind. Auto Battleships will be available on PC. You can wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3379080/Auto_Battleships/
title: Auto Battleships - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Join CEO & creative director Ares Dragonis for a closer look at the world of Necrophosis in this latest trailer for Necrophosis: Full Consciousness, which features the base game and the DLC for the first-person Lovecraftian horror game. Step into a nightmarish realm filled with grotesque forms and ominous visuals, solving unnerving puzzles and uncovering secrets along the way. 

Necrophosis: Full Consciousness will be available as a complete edition on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and Steam on May 28, 2026.
title: Necrophosis: Full Consciousness - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Black Cat Character Reveal Trailer for Marvel Rivals, the hit free-to-play third-person hero shooter developed by NetEase Games. Players will enter the fight as the iconic Felicia Hardy with Black Cat, bringing her claws to the game. Climb walls, make use of her whip, and pull off bad luck abilities to disrupt heroes and gain the edge in any encounter. Black Cat joins the lineup on April 17 with Season 7.5 for Marvel Rivals for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Marvel Rivals - Official Black Cat Character Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Release Date Announcement Trailer for Burgle Supply Company, a co-op horror comedy game developed by Terrible Posture Games. Players will join forces to head into suburban homes to burglarize them to their heart's content. Steal loot, take on optional objectives, and come face to face with grotesque monsters. Burgle Supply Company is launching on May 12 for PC (Steam).
title: Burgle Supply Company - Official Release Date Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Demo Launch Trailer for Phantom Gear, a 2D action platformer developed by Bits Rule Games. Players will head straight into battle as Josephine to take on the dark forces of Ocular Force by way of battle armor and quick reflexes. Overcome platforming challenges, take on enemies, and explore vibrant levels for upgrades. Phantom Gear is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.
title: Phantom Gear - Official Demo Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Announcement Trailer for Fragmentary Order, an upcoming sci-fi multiplayer first-person shooter developed by Rant Gaming. Players will fight in a bleak future as an organization called the Core unites humanity's governments in the efforts of salvation from oblivion. Assume control of clone assets to fight across the solar system to find resources, complete contracts, and dispatch enemy players on the battlefields of hostile planets. Fragmentary Order is coming soon.
title: Fragmentary Order - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Alaska Gold Fever is out now on Steam. Step into the role of a gold prospector during the Alaskan gold rush and build your own empire from scratch. Mine resources, refine different forms of gold, and upgrade your tools to increase efficiency. Explore diverse mines, survive the harsh climate, and complete engaging story and side quests.
title: Alaska Gold Fever - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get another look at Silicone Heart in this new trailer for the upcoming cozy cyber-farming sim and automation adventure game. In Silicone Heart, build a self-sustaining cyber farm on a planet-sized junkyard. Grow biomechanical crops, automate production, repair discarded robots, and secretly reshape a mechanical society from the inside. Silicone Heart will be available on PC, and a Kickstarter campaign is now live.
title: Silicone Heart - Official Kickstarter Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Season 7.5 Dev Vision Vol. 16 for Marvel Rivals, the hit free-to-play action hero shooter developed by NetEase Games. Players can get the rundown on what's in store for the mid-season update, including Black Cat joining the fight as a Duelist, a new PvE mode called Blood Hunt, the 2026 Hellfire Gala Event with new cosmetics, and more. Experience the beginning of The Path to Doomsday event with the original Avengers facing off against Loki, mirroring the hit 2012 Avengers film. Season 7.5 for Marvel Rivals kicks off on April 17 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Marvel Rivals - Official Season 7.5 Dev Vision Vol. 16

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Multiplayer Update Launch Trailer for Dome Keeper, a sci-fi action mining roguelike developed by Bippinbits. Players can now join forces with the introduction of multiplayer to play together across relic hunt, assignments, and prestige. A new Versus mode has also been added to incorporate competition with teams of keepers going head-to-head. The Multiplayer Update for Dome Keeper is available now for Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Game Pass, and PC (Steam).
title: Dome Keeper - Official Multiplayer Update Launch Trailer

description: Check out the Zero Dam Operations Map Update Trailer for Delta Force, the hit first-person free-to-play action shooter developed by Team Jade. Players can take a look at the new additions with the Operation Map, Zero Dam, where a new elevator extract can be utilized, updated to swimming and waterfront vegetation, treasures to find, and more. Experience the new updates to Zero Dam with Season Echo for Delta Force, launching on April 21 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, iOS, Android, and PC (Steam, Windows, and Epic Games Store).
title: Delta Force - Official Zero Dam Operations Map Update Trailer

description: Don't miss the Multi-Class Weapon Pack Launch Trailer for theHunter: Call of the Wild, the hit first-person hunting action shooter developed by Avalanche Studios. The Multi-Class Weapon Pack DLC is available now for theHunter: Call of the Wild for PlayStation 4 (PS4), Xbox One, and PC (Steam, Windows, and Epic Games Store).

author: GameTrailers
description:
Meet the Engineer class and learn about their abilities, such as setting up advanced machinery to take out enemies, in this latest Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor trailer for the single-player survivor-like auto-shooter game. In Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor, take on hordes of lethal aliens, mine riches, and unlock powerful upgrades to survive, as you wield the full arsenal of Deep Rock Galactic. It's one dwarf against all of Planet Hoxxes! 

Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor is available now on Xbox Series X/S, PC, the App Store, and Google Play.
title: Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor - Official Engineer Class Trailer

title: Parasol Superstars - Official Launch Trailer

description: Take a look at the Early Access Launch Trailer for Windrose, an online PvE survival pirate adventure game developed by Kraken Express. Players will set out into the unforgiving open world to live out the pirate's life through engaging in combat by land or sea, seeking legendary treasure, and taking on challenging bosses alone or with friends in co-op. Windrose is available now in Early Access for PC (Steam and Epic Games).
title: Windrose - Official Early Access Launch Trailer

description: Enjoy the Early Access launch trailer for Valorborn, the upcoming single-player medieval fantasy RPG sandbox where you can become whomever you want to be as you attempt to survive this world alone or with a party of customized characters. Valorborn will be available in Steam Early Access on April 15. Wishlist it if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3372530/Valorborn/

description: Check out 10 Minutes of Gameplay from Zombutcher: Monster Business Simulator, a first-person zombie meat shop simulation game developed by ODIUS. Don't miss 10 minutes of gameplay for Zombutcher: Monster Business Simulator, coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Zombutcher: Monster Business Simulator - Official 10 Minutes of Gameplay

description:

Pragmata is launching on April 17 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).

Source: https://youtube.com/nvidia

description: Dosa Divas is available now on Steam, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S. Watch the Dosa Divas launch trailer for this narrative turn-based RPG. In Dosa Divas, battle an evil fast food empire. Two sisters and their upgradable spirit-mech cook delicious meals, fight corpos, build up your reputation with local communities, and reconcile with loved ones.
title: Dosa Divas - Official Launch Trailer

description: Don't miss the Announcement Trailer for Checkpoint Z, a top-down action roguelike shooter developed by Claridge Games. Players will fight within an undead city from round to round. description: Check out the Gameplay Reveal Trailer for Clockfall, an action roguelite dungeon crawler defense game developed by Rever Games. Players will embark on the fight of a lifetime in a nightmare loop, requiring exploration and brutal combat to line up a great escape. Acquire resources, upgrades, and more from run to run to take on enemy after enemy and larger-than-life bosses. Master the clock in Clockfall, coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC.
